mapper.sql: id, parent_id, department_name, description, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO departments (parent_id, department_name, description, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted, deleted_at) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{departmentName}, #{description}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{deleted}, #{deletedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE departments SET parent_id = #{parentId}, department_name = #{departmentName}, description = #{description}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, is_deleted = #{deleted}, deleted_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM departments WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = FALSE
